backend/main.mo: Motoko backend implementing admin auth, AdMob config storage, session management, and user profile access with permission checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to related frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-style list of short summaries for all frontend source files describing their purpose.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining color variables and light/dark theme tokens.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML template that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/README.md: Project documentation explaining prototype features, setup steps, admin flow, and security notes.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with hash routing, admin access check, header navigation, and panel switching.
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Authentication and profile-setup gate that loads or initializes the user profile before showing protected content.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading states and error handling.
frontend/src/components/RewardedAdStubMo: Simulated rewarded-ad modal with timed progress, play state, and completion/cancel callbacks.
VPN session UI showing lock status, remaining time, ad‑unlock flow, and disconnect handling.
frontend/src/config/admob.ts: Placeholder AdMob config for app ID, rewarded unit ID, and simulation settings.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages backend actor instances tied to Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminPanel.ts: Admin hooks for checking admin status and fetching a placeholder admin overview.
frontend/src/hooks/useAppAdMobConfig.ts: Hooks to get and update AdMob configuration via the backend actor.
Mutation hook that clears sessions and refreshes session status.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, logout, and stored identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Hooks for fetching and saving the caller's user profile using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSessionStatus.ts: Session status hook that fetches session info, computes remaining time, and auto‑refetches when active.
frontend/src/hooks/useUnlockSession.ts: Provides a React Query mutation that calls actor.unlockSessions and refreshes session status.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and OKLCH theme variables for light/dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Renders the admin panel UI with admin checks, overview loading, and AdMob config editing.
frontend/src/utils/timeFormat.ts: Formats a seconds value into HH:MM:SS strings.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Handles URL parameter parsing, session persistence, and cleanup for hash/query params.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme extensions, colors, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Describes project state, admin panel enhancements, and pending feature requests.
